Tom says, 'We live in the neighborhood. There is a fountain in the square, and a statue of a man.'

Yes. We live in the neighborhood, and it is nice.
Is there a fountain in the town?
Yes. The fountain is in the square.
What is the statue in the square?
It is a statue of a man from our town.

The water is clear, and children play near it.' Lily says, 'Yes. I like the fountain. What is the statue in the square?' Tom says, 'It is a statue of a man from our town. He was a good man, and people like him.' Lily says, 'We shop in the town center. The shops are good, and the park is near.' Tom says, 'Yes. Our neighborhood is quiet, and the town center is busy. I can talk about my town.'
